name: Singita Sasakwa Lodge
insider_take: Singita Sasakwa Lodge channels the grandeur of an Edwardian manor house in the heart of the Serengeti, where colonial elegance meets untamed African wilderness.
whats_special: This exclusive lodge sits on a hilltop overlooking 350,000 acres of pristine wilderness in the Grumeti Reserves, offering front-row seats to the Great Migration. The property features its own equestrian center - one of the few places in Africa where you can horseback ride alongside zebras and wildebeest. Each suite comes with a private infinity pool and telescope for stargazing under some of the world's darkest skies.
pro_tip: Book during July-October for the best chance to witness river crossings from your suite's private deck, and don't miss the complimentary hot air balloon safaris available exclusively to lodge guests.
dont_miss: The lodge's world-class wine cellar houses over 60,000 bottles, making it one of Africa's most extensive collections. Take advantage of the complimentary tennis court and croquet lawn, or join the resident astronomer for guided constellation tours using the lodge's professional-grade telescopes.
pros: Exceptional safari experience with prime wildlife viewing in the Serengeti
Luxurious accommodations with elegant colonial-style architecture and furnishings
Outstanding personalized service with dedicated staff and expert guides
Exclusive location offering privacy and unparalleled access to migration routes
cons: Remote location requires chartered flights and extensive travel planning
Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning and limited availability
This property is not available for online booking.
